title: Puns and the Ethics of Being Understood
text:
Hebrew writers have long used wordplay as a test of their readers' attention. A line that appears to describe a garden may, on a second reading, comment on a marriage, and the reader who notices the shift is invited to become a co-author of the meaning. Such ambiguity is not merely clever; it asks the reader to take responsibility for the interpretation they choose.

Critics have debated whether a text that depends on double meaning is fair to readers who miss it. Some argue that deliberate obscurity betrays the reader, while others reply that the best puns reward attention without excluding anyone who reads carefully. The tension between generosity and difficulty remains central to how wordplay is judged.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what may a line that appears to describe a garden comment on?
According to the second paragraph, what do some critics argue deliberate obscurity does?
options: It removes the need for editing

questions.text: What does the passage imply about a reader who notices a shift in meaning?
options: They have no role in the interpretation
They become a co-author of the meaning
They are necessarily more intelligent than others

questions.text: Why is the tension between generosity and difficulty central to judging wordplay?
options: Because wordplay is always easy to understand
Because the best puns reward attention without excluding careful readers, yet obscurity can exclude
Because readers never disagree about wordplay
Because difficulty is always a sign of good writing

vocabulary.definition: the quality of allowing more than one possible meaning
the state of being difficult to see, understand or notice
the particular meaning a reader assigns to a text
willingness to give more than is strictly required, here toward the reader

paragraph_translations: כותבים עבריים השתמשו זה מכבר במשחקי מילים כמבחן לתשומת הלב של קוראיהם. שורה שנראית כמתארת גן עשויה, בקריאה שנייה, להעיר על נישואין, והקורא שמבחין בתזוזה מוזמן להפוך לשותף לכתיבת המשמעות. עמימות כזו אינה רק חכמה; היא דורשת מהקורא לקחת אחריות על הפרשנות שהוא בוחר.

המבקרים התווכחו אם טקסט התלוי בכפל משמעות הוגן לקוראים שמפספסים אותו. יש הטוענים שחוסר בהירות מכוון בוגד בקורא, ואחרים משיבים שהטובים שבמשחקי המילים מתגמלים את תשומת הלב בלי להדיר איש הקורא בזהירות. המתח בין נדיבות לקושי נותר מרכזי בדרך שבה נשפט משחק מילים.
